summary.prose: Building this Story adds one small MCP tool, insrc_present, and a live-only list of declared documents on the chat's tool-call event, read from each provider's own tool-call input (Claude's tool_use, Codex's mcp_tool_call with the shape captured and pinned from a real run). The presenter then opens exactly those pending documents and reports any that are not pending, the chat host feeds it from both paths and shows the outcome, the steering tells the controller to declare, and the old reading of tool output and the end-of-turn guess are removed last. Steering-only enforcement is accepted for now and the plan notes it should be revisited if it proves unreliable. The Codex chat live check is deferred to a follow-up.

tasks.title: Verify the existing symbols match the LLD
tasks.summary: Before changing anything, confirm that createReviewPresenter and its PresentedTurn handle, the exported presentedPathOf, the tool-call TurnEvent in stream-events.ts, and the Claude and Codex mappers in cli-adapter.ts have the shapes the LLD assumes (toolResult and end on the handle; no input on the tool-call event; Codex handling only command_execution and tool_call on item.completed). Record the symbols and shapes found as the task's reported evidence (no test is added); stop and report if any differs.
acceptanceChecks: Each of the existing symbols the LLD changes or removes was read in the code and its shape is recorded against the LLD's before state
Any difference from the LLD is reported, not worked around

tasks.title: Add the insrc_present MCP tool
tasks.summary: Add the insrc_present input shape to the schema registry, a workflow.pending wrapper in daemon-stream.ts, a handler that resolves the repo as insrc_workflow_approve does and answers presented and notPending against the pending list (a record with no document file is not presentable; ids matched without regard to the case of the story part; one to twenty names), register the tool in server.ts, and update the pins: the golden tool-surface fixture (inserted in name-sorted position, count thirteen, the 'twelve tools' title and length check in forward-step.test.ts), EXPECTED_TOOLS and PHASELESS_TOOLS in schema-registry.test.ts, and the steering tool-catalog row in steering-block.md (the only steering edit in this task; the prose is t7).
acceptanceChecks: insrc_present answers presented and notPending for pending and non-pending names and rejects an empty, oversized or non-string list
With no resolvable repo the tool answers an error and presents nothing
The golden fixture, forward-step test and schema registry tests pass with thirteen tools

tasks.title: Carry the declared documents on the tool-call event (Claude)
tasks.summary: Add the optional live-only present list to the tool-call TurnEvent in stream-events.ts and set it in the Claude mapper from the tool_use input's documents when the tool is insrc_present (an array of at most twenty non-empty strings; anything else leaves it absent). Every other tool-call event is unchanged and the field is never written to the saved transcript.

tasks.title: Map the Codex mcp_tool_call item
tasks.summary: Give the Codex mapper in cli-adapter.ts a branch for mcp_tool_call items on item.completed only: set the event's mcp from server and tool, and when tool is exactly insrc_present set present from arguments.documents (an object, no JSON-string form); ignore item.started so a call declares once, and still declare when the item's status is failed. command_execution and tool_call items map as before. Tested against the pinned codex-mcp-tool-call.jsonl capture. The mapper stays pinned to codex-cli 0.162.1 with no drift warning.
acceptanceChecks: The pinned real capture maps to exactly one tool-call event with present set, from the completed item

Another tool, a server-qualified tool name, or string arguments set no present, and command_execution and tool_call items map as before

tasks.title: Presenter: open exactly the declared documents
tasks.summary: Change the presenter's turn handle in review-presenter.ts from toolResult and end to declared(documents) returning a DeclaredOutcome (opened, notPending, unreadable) and end. declared resolves each name against the pending list (artifact id without regard to the case of the story part, or path), opens each match once per turn in order, reports names that are not pending, logs and reports an unreadable list, and never throws. The old toolResult, presentedPathOf and end-of-turn guess are left in place for now so the build stays green; they are removed in t8.
acceptanceChecks: A declared id and a declared path each open the matching pending document once, in order
A name that is not pending opens nothing and is reported by name; an unreadable list or a failing open is logged and never thrown
The same document declared twice in a turn opens once, and ids match without regard to the case of the story part

tasks.title: Chat host feeds declarations and shows the outcome
tasks.summary: In chat-panel.ts pass each tool-call event's present list to the presented turn's declared() on both feed paths (the followed live turn and the hosted run) with the existing guarded helpers, and show the DeclaredOutcome as chat information lines (a name that is not pending, an unreadable pending list). extension.ts keeps building the presenter as today.

tasks.title: Rewrite the steering and guide text
tasks.summary: Rewrite the approval and guide prose in steering-block.md so the controller calls insrc_present with the documents it asks the user to review before it asks for approval, and also gives the document's path in its message; the catalog row stays as t2 left it, and the steering-template needs no change beyond pointing at the block. Add a plain note that steering-only enforcement is accepted for now and should be revisited (a daemon-side reminder in tool responses, or detection of a missing call) if it proves unreliable. Update the steering-text pins in the tests.
acceptanceChecks: The steering block and guide tell the controller to call insrc_present before asking for approval and to give the path in its message
The steering text carries the revisit note for steering-only enforcement
The steering-text tests pass

tests.name: the steering block, the steering template and the guide tell the controller to call insrc_present before it asks for approval

tasks.title: Remove the output-parsing path and run the live checks
tasks.summary: Once everything above is in, remove presentedPathOf, toolResult on the presented turn, the chat host's tool-result feed to the presenter and the end-of-turn opening of whatever became pending, along with the TurnState fields only they used and the tests that pinned them. Nothing in the chat reads a tool result to decide what to open. Then run the live check against the finished behaviour: a declared document opens in the review pane even when the workflow result was large. The Codex chat live check (a Codex turn that calls insrc_present opens the declared document) is deferred by the user to a follow-up, because the insrc MCP server is not registered in Codex; until it is run, the Codex mapper rests on the unit tests against the pinned real capture.
